bagPolicy.summary: Ford Center permits clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12 by 6 by 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags, and small clutches up to 4.5 by 6.5 inches. Medical exceptions are inspected at a designated gate.
allowed: Clear bag up to 12 by 6 by 12 inches
Small clutch up to 4.5 by 6.5 inches
bagPolicy.note: All guests and belongings are subject to screening, and event-specific restrictions may be added.

parking.note: Parking assignments and prices vary by Ford Center event. Review the event page and The Star campus information before arrival; Blue and Silver garages and the Gridiron Lot serve parts of the campus.

rideshare.note: On event days, use the area outside Ford Center’s Media Entrance on Gaylord Parkway for rideshare pickup and drop-off.

concessions.note: Food and beverages are sold inside Ford Center for many events. Outside food, alcohol, bottles, cans, and beverage containers are prohibited, with exceptions for medical needs.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Ford Center has accessible parking, accessible drop-off and pick-up areas, power-assisted doors, and accessible restrooms, concessions, and seating. Wheelchair and companion seating is on the concourse level, and a limited number of wheelchairs can take you from the gates to your seat if you ask event staff at any entrance. For help on event day, visit the Guest Services Center on the concourse behind Section 127.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Some Ford Center events allow re-entry. If allowed, use a designated exit and have your ticket scanned out. Repeat security screening when you return. Frisco ISD events prohibit re-entry.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Ford Center ticket offices are at the southwest and southeast corners of Ford Center, accessed through Tostitos Championship Plaza. They open on event days, with hours set for each event.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Ford Center has one guest entrance. Use the South Entrance, on the south side of the building through the plaza.
